links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of candidate LLMs versus human coders on the same NICU notes, physician-adjudicated
links.effect: GPT-o3-mini 79.1% vs human coders 76.3% (P=.52); GPT-4o 58.6% (P<.001 vs both), so the comparison separated a comparable model from an underperforming one.
links.quote: GPT-4o underperformed at 58.6% (95% CI, 52.5%-64.7%; P < .001 vs both).

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs as adjuncts to human coders for diagnosis coding and DRG assignment to improve reimbursement

screen.reason: Retrospective study comparing the diagnostic coding accuracy and financial impact of LLMs (GPT-4o, GPT-o3-mini) versus human coders on neonatal ICU notes, adjudicated by clinicians.
